name: input-group
useFor: Use when a field needs a unit, a prefix, a status or an action inside its border: an amount in USD, a domain, a Copy key on an API key, a search mark. Use InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea as the control and InputGroupAddon (align inline-start, inline-end, block-start or block-end) around it.
constraints: A second border inside the group
source: Extrapolated from agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field input) and the brand's keys
title: Input Group
description: The square field with labels, marks, a sunken segment or small keys inside it.
